name: Compose LinkedIn draft (no auto-post)
description: Open LinkedIn share box and type the top scored draft. Dry-run types text and does NOT click Post. Publish only with CONTENT_DO_PUBLISH=true and --no-dry-run.

env.name: CONTENT_DRY_RUN
env.description: Type into composer but never click Post

env.name: CONTENT_COMPOSE_DRAFT_ID
env.description: Optional specific draft id; else highest score

env.name: CONTENT_MIN_SCORE
env.description: Min score when auto-picking a draft

env.name: CONTENT_COMPOSE_REVIEW_MS
env.description: How long to leave text visible before closing (dry-run)

env.name: CONTENT_DO_PUBLISH
env.description: Only with --no-dry-run: click Post after typing

env.name: CONTENT_ATTACH_IMAGE
env.description: Generate a title card and attach it in the share box

env.name: CONTENT_IMAGE_AI
env.description: Design card copy from ## Image in instructions.md via Cursor/AI

env.name: CONTENT_IMAGE_PATH
env.description: Optional PNG/JPG to attach instead of the generated card
